title: Complete Sri Lanka Experience

itinerary.title: Arrival in Colombo
itinerary.description: Welcome to Sri Lanka! Our representative will greet you at the airport and transfer you to your hotel in Colombo. Spend the rest of the day relaxing or take a brief city tour in the evening.

itinerary.title: Sigiriya Rock Fortress
itinerary.description: After breakfast, head to the Cultural Triangle. Climb the iconic Sigiriya Rock Fortress, a UNESCO World Heritage site featuring ancient frescoes and a stunning view of the surrounding jungle.

itinerary.title: Sacred City of Kandy
itinerary.description: Travel to Kandy, visiting a spice garden en route. In the evening, visit the sacred Temple of the Tooth Relic and enjoy a traditional cultural dance performance.
